question: Which single product generated the highest total revenue (price + freight) across all its orders in 2017?
sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS times_ordered FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which payment method is used most frequently by customers, by number of transactions?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were delivered later than their estimated delivery date?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

question: What's the average review score for orders that were delivered late?
sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score_when_late FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date;

question: Among orders that were delivered late, which product category has the highest average delivery delay in days?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_estimated_delivery_date)) AS avg_delay_days FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many unique customers are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM customers;

question: Which Brazilian state has the most customers?
sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What's the average freight cost as a percentage of item price?
sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value / price) * 100 AS avg_freight_pct FROM order_items WHERE price > 0;

question: Which seller generated the highest total revenue, and across how many distinct orders?
sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Among 1-star reviews, what percentage of those orders were delivered late?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_late FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

question: Which order status appears most often, and how many orders have that status?
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which month had the highest number of orders?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which English product category has the highest number of order items?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which payment type has the highest average number of installments?
sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(payment_installments) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY avg_installments DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which customer state has the highest average review score?
sql: SELECT customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which seller state has the most sellers?
sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were canceled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: Which month had the highest delivered-order revenue including freight?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Among product categories with at least 100 reviews, which category has the lowest average review score?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english HAVING review_count >= 100 ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers made more than one purchase?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM customers GROUP BY customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);
